T: Santa needs a Mrs. And a menu.
D: Scott Calvin has to find a Mrs. Claus before Christmas Eve or stop being Santa for good.
P: Serve the cocoa when Scott takes Carol on their first date.
S: Buttery cut-out cookies iced red and green
Iced Christmas sugar cookies cut into stars and trees, the kind the elves keep piled up all over the workshop.
Cheddar and cream cheese ball with cranberries, rolled in walnuts

A creamy cheddar and cream cheese ball studded with dried cranberries, rolled in toasted walnuts and parsley, with crackers for the party. Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 150g grated vintage cheddar, 60g chopped dried cranberries, 1 tbsp chopped chives and 1/2 tsp garlic powder. Shape into a ball, wrap in cling film and chill for 1 hour until firm. Toast 70g walnuts in a dry pan for 4 minutes, chop finely and mix with 2 tbsp chopped parsley. Roll the ball in the mix until coated. Serve with 200g crackers.
M: Thyme butter roast chicken with potatoes and carrots
Golden roast chicken with herbs, potatoes and carrots, a warm Christmas dinner fit for the future Mrs. Claus.
Pumpkin, carrot and parsnip with maple and thyme, a Council favourite
Pumpkin, carrots and parsnips roasted until caramelised, glazed with maple syrup and thyme, finished with toasted pecans.
W: Chocolate brownies with white chocolate and crushed candy cane

Fudgy dark chocolate brownies with a layer of peppermint white chocolate and crushed candy canes on top. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g caster sugar, then 3 eggs, 1/2 tsp peppermint extract and a pinch of salt. Fold in 100g plain flour and 30g cocoa. Spread into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 170C for 25 minutes until just set. Cool completely. Melt 120g white chocolate and spread over the top, then scatter with 4 crushed candy canes. Chill 20 minutes and cut into 16 squares.
K: Hot chocolate with peppermint, whipped cream and a candy cane

Rich hot chocolate made with real dark and milk chocolate and a hint of peppermint, topped with whipped cream and a candy cane to stir. Heat 1L full cream milk with 2 tbsp caster sugar until steaming but not boiling. Whisk in 100g chopped milk chocolate, 50g chopped dark chocolate and 1 tbsp cocoa until smooth and frothy. Stir in 1/4 tsp peppermint extract. Pour into 4 mugs and top each with a big spoon of whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream. Hang a candy cane on each mug to stir.
